summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of the second tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme. Under the tranche announced on 6 May 2026, Equinor repurchased 3,534,975 shares at a weighted average price of NOK 335.2349 per share, representing 0.15% of share capital. Transactions occurred on the OSE, CEUX, and TQEX venues. Post-completion, Equinor holds 14,255,775 own shares (0.60% including shares under a savings programme). This is a routine capital return execution, not a special situation requiring categorization as a Capital Return; it is an ordinary continuation of an announced programme.
